rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who cooperates and for something done jointly.

example.english: This was a cooperative project between the two schools.
example.traditional: 呢個係兩間學校合作搞嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 loeng5 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hap6 zok3 gaau2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when someone is willing to comply with or assist another person, especially in treatment or instructions.

example.english: They were very cooperative during physiotherapy.
example.traditional: 做物理治療嗰陣，佢好肯配合。
example.jyutping: zou6 mat6 lei5 zi6 liu4 go2 zan6 keoi5 hou2 hang2 pui3 hap6

rows.note: Use this to stress that someone is willing to work together rather than refusing to cooperate.

example.english: If you're cooperative, this will be much easier to deal with.
example.traditional: 你肯合作，件事就易辦好多。
example.jyutping: nei5 hang2 hap6 zok3 gin6 si6 zau6 ji6 baan6 hou2 do1
